hero_kpi_rationale: Net interest income forms the core of the banking business model and is the primary driver of profitability for HSBC. It reflects the bank's ability to generate stable revenues from its balance sheet, particularly in a higher interest rate environment where HSBC benefits from diversified international exposure.

kpis.name: Net Interest Income
kpis.explanation: Difference between interest received on assets and interest paid on liabilities, the primary driver of banking profitability.
kpis.description: Net Interest Income reached $35.8B in 2023, up $5.4B or +18% versus 2022 ($30.4B), reflecting higher interest rates across major currencies.
kpis.signal: Robust growth driven by elevated interest rates and increased interest-bearing assets

kpis.name: Net Interest Margin
kpis.explanation: Difference between interest revenue earned on loans and interest paid on deposits, expressed as a percentage of interest-bearing assets.
kpis.description: NIM improved to 1.66% in 2023 versus 1.42% in 2022, an increase of 24 basis points, driven by a rise in average yield on interest-bearing assets of 220 bps, partially offset by a 196 bps increase in funding costs.
kpis.signal: Improved profitability of interest-bearing assets due to elevated rates

kpis.name: Gross Interest Income
kpis.explanation: Total revenue generated by loans and interest-bearing assets before deduction of interest expense.
kpis.description: Interest income reached $100.9B in 2023, up $48.0B or +90% versus 2022 ($52.9B), primarily driven by the impact of higher market interest rates.
kpis.signal: Massive increase in gross interest income due to higher interest rate environment

kpis.name: Operating Expenses
kpis.explanation: Total operating costs including salaries, technology costs and other operational expenses.
kpis.description: Operating expenses totaled $32.1B in 2023, down $0.6B or -2% versus 2022 ($32.7B), reflecting improved cost discipline and completion of the restructuring program.
kpis.signal: Cost discipline driven by management discipline and completion of the cost reduction program

kpis.name: Cost-to-Income Ratio
kpis.explanation: Share of operating costs in total revenue: the lower it is, the more efficient the bank is.
kpis.description: Cost-to-income ratio improved to approximately 49.9% in 2023 versus 52.7% in 2022, reflecting improved operational efficiency driven by robust growth in net interest income in a higher rate environment, partially offset by increased charges.
kpis.signal: Significant improvement in operational efficiency driven by revenue growth and cost discipline

kpis.name: Expected Credit Loss Charge
kpis.explanation: Provision for expected credit losses, an indicator of portfolio quality and economic risks.
kpis.description: Expected credit loss charges totaled $3.85B in 2025, down versus 2024, including provisions for commercial real estate sector exposures. Charges reflect a normalized economic environment with prudent provisioning for risks.
kpis.signal: Prudent management of credit risk despite economic uncertainties and exposure to Chinese commercial real estate sector

kpis.name: Net Fee Income
kpis.explanation: Net commissions and fees earned on banking services, wealth management services and financing products.
kpis.description: Net fee income reached $11.8B in 2023, marginally above $11.7B in 2022, with gains in commercial banking offsetting declines in wealth management and brokerage.
kpis.signal: Stability in fee income despite headwinds in asset management and brokerage activities

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the past 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of €3,233.03B in the latest year

kpis.name: Trading and Fair Value Income
kpis.explanation: Net revenue generated by trading activities and fair value managed assets, an indicator of market operations performance.
kpis.description: Net revenue from trading instruments and fair value managed assets reached $16.7B in 2023, up $6.4B or +62% versus 2022 ($10.3B), reflecting strong trading performance in GBM particularly in Hong Kong and Europe.
kpis.signal: Exceptional market operations performance, notably in Asia and Europe

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Montant total versé en dividendes par action sur l'année fiscale.

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Total annuel : dividendes versés + rachats d'actions (treasury).
kpis.description: Cumulative dividends + share buybacks (2021-2025) in billions USD.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Part du bénéfice net redistribuée. >80 % = potentiellement non soutenable.

risks.title: Geopolitical risk and international sanctions
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned from the outset with high intensity (Russia-Ukraine, Middle East, China-US tensions, Hong Kong, Taiwan). Repeated and alarmist language ('material adverse effect'). Trend: stable/upward. Category weight: very high for global bank.

risks.title: Regulatory compliance and money laundering risk
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly mentioned: 'exposure to counterparty risk, including third parties using us as a conduit for illegal activities'. Direct language on operational and reputational risk. Trend: stable. Category weight: critical for global bank.

risks.title: Credit risk from commercial real estate in mainland China
risks.score_rationale: Specifically mentioned: 'deviations from market assumptions...ongoing developments in the commercial real estate sector in mainland China and Hong Kong'. Moderate language but context of major exposure. Trend: up (sector in crisis). Category weight: high for HSBC.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and technology infrastructure risks
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly cited: 'changes to the reliability and security of our data management...threats from cyber-attacks, which may impact our ability to service clients'. Direct language on operational impact. Trend: up (growing threats). Category weight: high for digital bank.

risks.title: Financial model risk and methodological limitations
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly mentioned: 'model limitations or failure...high inflationary pressures and interest rates have had on the performance and usage of financial models'. Technical language but capital impact (additional capital, losses). Trend: up (inflation/rates). Category weight: high.

risks.title: Increased competition from fintech and non-bank providers
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned: 'effects of competition in the markets where we operate including increased competition from non-bank financial services companies'. Moderate language but acknowledges structural threat. Trend: up. Category weight: medium-high.

risks.title: Credit rating risk and funding costs
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly cited: 'a reduction in the credit ratings assigned to us...could increase the cost or decrease the availability of our funding and affect our liquidity position and net interest margin'. Direct language on financial impact. Trend: stable. Category weight: critical.

risks.title: ESG risk and greenwashing reputational exposure
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned with emphasis: 'risk of greenwashing', 'may not be able to achieve our ESG-related ambitions', 'increase the risk of greenwashing'. Repeated language on inability to meet targets. Trend: up (growing regulatory expectations). Category weight: high.
